info.title: API.SH: Behance
info.description: The Behance API from API.SH: public Behance data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Without `gallery`: Behance's curated galleries (Best of Behance, Graphic Design, Photography, Illustration, 3D Art, UI/UX, Motion, Architecture, Product Design, Fashion, Advertising, Fine Arts, Crafts, Game Design, Sound and the Adobe tool galleries) with id, slug, name, description and link. With `gallery`: that gallery's featured projects, 24 a page (name, link, dates, appreciations, views, comments, fields, cover, featured and premium flags, owners). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/behance-galleries

parameters.name: gallery
parameters.description: Gallery slug (graphic-design, photography, best-of-behance, ui-ux, ...) or a behance.net/galleries link. Leave out to list galleries.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Creative jobs on the Behance job list, 24 a page: id, title, company and its website, city, state, country, full-time or freelance, status, salary range when given, posted and expiry times, link, the full description (HTML and text) and tags. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/behance-jobs

get.description:
A creator's (or team's) public Behance profile: name, occupation, company, location, website, about, avatar, banner, stats (project views, appreciations, followers, following), member since, Pro badge, availability (full time, freelance, remote), links, social profiles, work experience, featured-in galleries, profile sections, and the latest projects (cards as in search). Logged out, Behance shows one page of a profile's projects (`more_projects` says if there are more).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/behance-profile

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A behance.net profile link, instead of `username`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Projects on Behance for keywords and/or filters: sort (recommended, appreciations, views, comments, newest), time (today, week, month, all), creative field, tools, color and owner country. Each project: id, name, link, publish/modified dates, appreciations, views, comments, cover image, featured flag and owners (username, name, location, avatar, Pro). 24 projects a page: pass `next_page` back as `page` for the next 24 (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/behance-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `poster`. Required unless `field` or `tools` is given.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Creative field id, e.g. 109 Branding, 44 Graphic Design, 48 Illustration.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1), 24 projects a page; pass `next_page` back. The same filters apply on every page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Logged out, Behance shows the first page of a search (24 projects); pass page=2 and up for more.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
